objectives: 營建從業人員應需對工程會計具一定之認知與了解，以落實成本管控並符合現代高度整合專案工程之需求。本課程主要教導學生熟習會計之相關領域與原理，並佐以工程管理上之實例，幫助學生有效整合專案工程成本控制與施工管理。
content:
1	Course Introduction

2	Accounting in Action and Survey: Initial Assessment

3	Recording Process

4	Adjusting the Accounts

5	Completion of the Accounting Cycle

6	On-site Practice		*Lesson learned report (1)

7	Special Edition: Prof Yu, University of Massachusetts, USA		*Lesson learned report (2)

8	Managerial Accounting

9	Midterm Exam

10	Progress presentation		*Abstract due

11	Job Order Cost Accounting

12	Process Cost Accounting

13	Financial Statement Analysis

14	Special Edition: Practitioner		*Lesson learned report (3)

15	Project presentation (1)

16	Project presentation (2) and Feedback		*Project due
books:
1.	Weygandt, J. J., Kieso, D. E., ＆ Kimmel, P. D. (2011) Financial Accounting, ISBN: 9780470552001, John Wiley ＆ Sons, New York. (滄海代理)
2.	Halpin, W. D. (1985) Financial and Cost Concepts for Construction Management, ISBN: 0471897256, John Wiley ＆ Sons, New York.
3.	Horngren, C. T., Dater, S. M., and Foster, G. (2006) Cost Accounting, 12th ed. ISBN: 0131968521, Pearson Prentice Hall, Upper Saddle River, NJ. (東華代理)
